tools_used: metrics/statpack.md (modern cert, relist/CVSG cuts, sal-v4 band table)
WebFetch (supremecourt.gov dockets and PDFs) with local pypdf text extraction
helpful: Forward-mode web retrieval was decisive: the companion government petition (No. 26-204) and the SG's hold recommendation are not visible from this docket's own snapshot.
The sal-v4 band table with bracketed reached rates made the pooled anchor straightforward.
supremecourt.gov docket HTML fetched cleanly and gave the companion case's distribution date.
gaps: WebFetch cannot read PDF text; every supremecourt.gov brief had to be saved and extracted with pypdf by hand. A provisioned text of the respondents' brief (including the 'Brief for the Federal Respondents' caption the SG uses) would have saved most of the retrieval budget.
No provisioned pointer to related pending SCOTUS dockets on the same question; the companion petition had to be discovered through a web search.
The corpus has no cut for petitions whose respondent is the SG with a parallel government petition pending, so the key adjustment from the band anchor is unmeasured judgment.
The CourtListener RECAP docket index does not carry SCOTUS dockets, so the MCP search for the companion case returned nothing.
notes: 13 retrieval calls in total (one 403), under the advisory budget. The single corpus query added nothing for this posture.
